Hello,

Thanks for reaching out and welcome to Novig! Parlays on our exchange work a bit differently than traditional sportsbooks. Instead of betting against a bookmaker, you are trading directly with other users who take the opposite side of your prediction.

For parlays, each leg is combined into a single linked market where the price is determined by supply and demand from all users posting bids and offers. Other users do not have to take all legs individually; they effectively accept the entire parlay as a bundled outcome. The prices you see reflect what the market participants are willing to pay or receive based on the combined probabilities of all the outcomes in the parlay.

If you’d like, a member of our Support team can provide more detailed explanations or guide you through placing your first parlay trade.

Best,  
Novig Support
